mapper.select: select fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as productcode, DATE_FORMAT(fin.VDATE,'%Y%m%d') as establishdate, DATE_FORMAT(fin.ACTMDATE,'%Y%m%d') as expirydate, rule.YIELD as salefeerate, finadd.IS_LAY as islay from FIN_PRODUCT fin left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd on fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_CASH_INFO info on fin.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_ID and info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.IS_CALC = 'Y' left join (select finrule.CASH_ID as CASH_ID, max(finrule.EFF_DATE) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE finrule where finrule.EFF_DATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{cDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') group by finrule.CASH_ID ) dt on dt.CASH_ID = info.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rule on fin.FINPROD_ID = rule.FINPROD_ID and rule.EFF_DATE = dt.EFF_DATE and rule.CASH_ID = dt.CASH_ID where fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{productcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select CONCAT(CONCAT(IFNULL(layparam.AMT_MIN ,'') ,','), IFNULL( layparam.AMT_MAX,'')) as buyamtinterval, CONCAT(CONCAT(IFNULL( layparam.TERM_MIN ,''),','), IFNULL(layparam.TERM_MAX ,'')) as holddaysinterval, CONCAT(CONCAT(IFNULL( layparam.CUSTOM_LEVEL,'') ,','), IFNULL(layparam.CUSTOM_LEVEL ,'')) as clientlevelinterval, rule.YIELD as bedyield, (case rule.BASIS when 'A/365' then '365' when 'A/360' then '360' end) as yearinterestdays from PRD_LAYER_PARAM layparam left join FIN_CASH_INFO info on info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.FINPROD_TYPE = #{prodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.FINPROD_ID = layparam.FINPROD_ID left join (select finrule.CASH_ID as CASH_ID, max(finrule.EFF_DATE) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE finrule where finrule.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{cDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') group by finrule.CASH_ID ) dt on dt.CASH_ID = info.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rule on rule.CASH_ID =info.CASH_ID and rule.EFF_DATE = dt.EFF_DATE and rule.CASH_ID = dt.CASH_ID where layparam.FINPROD_ID in (select fin.FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT fin where fin.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select CONCAT('1' ,',', '999999999') as buyamtinterval, CONCAT('1' ,',', '9999') as holddaysinterval, CONCAT('0' ,',', '9') as clientlevelinterval, rule.YIELD as bedyield, rule.YIELD as bedyield, (case rule.BASIS when 'A/365' then '365' when 'A/360' then '360' end) as yearinterestdays from FIN_CASH_INFO info left join (select finrule.CASH_ID as CASH_ID, max(finrule.EFF_DATE) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE finrule where finrule.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{cDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') group by finrule.CASH_ID ) dt on dt.CASH_ID = info.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rule on rule.CASH_ID =info.CASH_ID and rule.EFF_DATE = dt.EFF_DATE where info.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.FINPROD_TYPE = #{prodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
